description: React component implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with state management, score tracking, theme toggling, and game logic.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner of the current Tic Tac Toe board based on predefined winning lines.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw (all squares filled with no winner).

methods.name: loadScores
methods.description: Loads the game scores (X wins, O wins, draws) from localStorage with validation.

methods.name: loadTheme
methods.description: Loads the theme preference ('light' or 'dark') from localStorage or defaults based on OS settings.
